@@f01 upsert fill text
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (id, fe) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET fe = COALESCE(NULLIF(repos.fe, ''), EXCLUDED.fe)
@@f02 upsert fill nullable alias
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos AS r (id, fe) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET fe = COALESCE(r.fe, EXCLUDED.fe)
@@f03 guarded bare update
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $2 WHERE id = $1 AND COALESCE(fe, '') = ''
@@f04 guarded bare update is null
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r
   SET fe = $2
 WHERE r.id = $1
   AND r.fe IS NULL
@@f05 prefer nonempty
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (id, pn) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET pn = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.pn, ''), repos.pn)
@@f06 prefer nonempty schema-qualified stored
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (id, pn) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET pn = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.pn, ''), aveloxis_data.repos.pn)
@@f07 prefer nonnull
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET pnn = COALESCE($2, pnn) WHERE id = $1
@@f08 greatest
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (id, g) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET g = GREATEST(COALESCE(EXCLUDED.g, repos.g), COALESCE(repos.g, EXCLUDED.g))
@@f09 always refresh now
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = NOW() WHERE id = $1
@@f10 always refresh excluded
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (id, ar) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET ar = EXCLUDED.ar, x = EXCLUDED.x
@@f11 earliest
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (id, e) VALUES ($1, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET e = LEAST(repos.e, EXCLUDED.e)
@@f12 keep carry
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (id, k) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET k = CASE WHEN repos.cls = EXCLUDED.cls THEN repos.k WHEN $3::timestamptz IS NOT NULL THEN $3::timestamptz ELSE NOW() END
@@f13 insertonly untouched in conflict
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (id, io) VALUES ($1, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET x = EXCLUDED.x
@@f14 batch unnest insert
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (id, fe) SELECT * FROM unnest($1::bigint[], $2::text[]) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
@@f15 cte update returning then insert
WITH moved AS (UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET x = $2 WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id, fe) INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.log (id, fe) SELECT id, fe FROM moved
@@f16 delete using
DELETE FROM aveloxis_data.repos r USING aveloxis_data.other o WHERE r.id = o.id AND r.fe IS NULL
@@f17 update from values
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET x = v.x FROM (VALUES ($1::bigint, $2::text)) AS v(id, x) WHERE r.id = v.id
@@f18 guarded bare with FROM unnest
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET fe = v.fe FROM unnest($1::bigint[], $2::text[]) AS v(id, fe) WHERE r.id = v.id AND COALESCE(r.fe, '') = ''
@@f19 DO block migration with if exists
DO $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'x') THEN ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos ADD CONSTRAINT x CHECK (id > 0) NOT VALID; END IF; END $$
@@f20 alter add column if not exists
ALTER TABLE aveloxis_data.repos ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS added_at2 TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
@@f21 create index concurrently
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_x ON aveloxis_data.repos (lower(fe)) WHERE fe <> ''
@@f22 select for update skip locked
SELECT id FROM aveloxis_data.repos WHERE fe IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT $1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
@@f23 advisory lock
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock($1)
@@f24 guard with extra parens
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE (COALESCE(fe, '') = '') AND id = $2
@@f25 guard or-empty form (natural)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE id = $2 AND (fe IS NULL OR fe = '')
@@f26 guard nullif is null (natural)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE id = $2 AND NULLIF(fe, '') IS NULL
@@f27 guard schema-qualified column
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1 WHERE aveloxis_data.repos.fe IS NULL
@@f28 fill with cast param
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = COALESCE(fe, $1::text)
@@f29 guarded bare with cast param
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET fe = $1::text WHERE fe IS NULL
@@f30 greatest with cast
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET g = GREATEST(COALESCE($1::timestamptz, g), COALESCE(g, $1::timestamptz))
@@f31 plpgsql with %ROWTYPE read only
DO $$ DECLARE r aveloxis_data.repos%ROWTYPE; BEGIN SELECT * INTO r FROM aveloxis_data.repos LIMIT 1; RAISE NOTICE '%', r.fe; END $$
@@f32 plpgsql with %TYPE
DO $$ DECLARE v aveloxis_data.repos.fe%TYPE; BEGIN SELECT fe INTO v FROM aveloxis_data.repos LIMIT 1; END $$
@@f33 plpgsql composite var field assign (not NEW)
DO $$ DECLARE r aveloxis_data.other; BEGIN r.a := 1; END $$
@@f34 trigger fn that only stamps another col
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION aveloxis_data.touch() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN NEW.touched := NOW(); RETURN NEW; END $$
@@f35 plpgsql execute format for index (run-time)
DO $$ BEGIN EXECUTE format('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS %I ON aveloxis_data.other (a)', 'i'); END $$
@@f36 PG18 returning with
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET x = $1 RETURNING WITH (OLD AS o) o.x
@@f37 update other col with subquery from same table
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET x = (SELECT count(*) FROM aveloxis_data.repos q WHERE q.fe = r.fe)
@@f38 ar from subquery of other table with same col name
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = (SELECT max(s.ar) FROM s.stg s WHERE s.id = r.id)
@@f39 refresh/analyze/vacuum
ANALYZE aveloxis_data.repos; VACUUM (ANALYZE) aveloxis_data.repos
@@f40 set local + update in one text
SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '5s'; UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET x = 1 WHERE id = $1
@@f41 view over registered and select
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW aveloxis_augur_data.repo AS SELECT id, fe FROM aveloxis_data.repos
@;
SELECT fe FROM aveloxis_augur_data.repo
@@f42 view over registered; update of ANOTHER column through... a different table with same name in other schema
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW aveloxis_augur_data.repo AS SELECT id, fe FROM aveloxis_data.repos
@;
INSERT INTO aveloxis_augur_data.repo (id) VALUES (1)
